Scarlet & Violet series · PAR

Paradox Rift

Released November 3, 2023 · 266 cards

StandardExpanded

Paradox Rift is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on November 3, 2023. Its main set has 182 cards, plus 84 secret rares numbered beyond the set (266 in total). It includes 222 Pokémon, 42 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
